evidence.title: VNET Group, Inc. Earnings Presentation for 1Q26
evidence.excerpt: VNET's 1Q26 presentation reports eight wholesale data-center components under construction across the Yangtze River Delta and Greater Beijing Area as of March 31, 2026.

metadata.capture_artifact_guardrail: The exact official PDF response body and rendered verification pages were temporary verification artifacts and are not redistributed in this derived record.

metadata.failed_cli_attempt_guardrail: Command-line attempts that stalled or returned an HTTP/2 internal error delivered no PDF body and are not represented as evidence; the content hash binds only the successful 200 Chrome CDP response stream.
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at is the successful response's whole-second HTTP Date and the completed local PDF capture timestamp.

metadata.raw_table_consistency_guardrail: Displayed numbers and strings are transcribed as shown: 100.0 percent values remain JSON 100.0, and N-HB03 remains source-reported as 4 MW under construction, 4 MW pre-committed, and 91.4 percent. No rate is recomputed and no internal consistency is implied.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The presentation labels the figures only as capacity under construction and capacity pre-committed. They are not mapped to critical IT load, gross facility demand, grid connection, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, PUE, or measured consumption, so no normalized capacity rows are created.
metadata.aggregate_guardrail: The 516 MW construction total and 443 MW pre-committed subtotal are retained only as raw evidence metadata and are not emitted as aggregate or component capacity observations.
metadata.rfs_guardrail: Ready-for-Service half-year values are forward-looking source strings retained only in evidence metadata; they create no exact target date, achieved RFS, completion, commissioning, energization, or operational observation.
metadata.site_count_guardrail: The eight operator-reported rows are construction components, not verified unique physical sites. The two regional campus entities are non-geographic grouping anchors and do not establish a physical campus or site count.
metadata.locality_guardrail: The source assigns only Yangtze River Delta or Greater Beijing Area. It supplies no city, province, address, coordinates, parcel, footprint, or geometry, and none are inferred.
metadata.operating_model_scope: The presentation expressly identifies the table as wholesale capacity, supporting one wholesale_colocation classification for each construction component.
metadata.role_guardrail: VNET authorship and the table's Owned or Leased tenure labels do not by themselves assign standardized operator, owner, landlord, developer, investor, contractor, tenant, customer, or user roles.
metadata.workload_guardrail: Portfolio and customer-sector wording elsewhere in the presentation is not component-specific and creates no AI, cloud, internet, local-services, or other normalized workload observation.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The source states no annual energy, current load, grid-connection metric, PUE, renewable consumption, generation, or measured consumption for these components.
metadata.held_for_future_exclusion: The separate held-for-future-development table is outside this bounded tranche and creates no entity, lifecycle, classification, or capacity row.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from an all-rights-reserved official investor-relations presentation; the captured PDF is not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, analyst geolocation, or image-based inference contributes to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, role, operating model, workload, or energy classification.
